description:
Doug sinks through every layer of the ocean, from the sunlit surface to the bottom of the Mariana Trench, and each zone of the deep sea gets its own real creature (and its own chance to kill him).

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
